title: Sheboygan County Museum

services.name: Group Admission
services.desc: Over the past several years, the Sheboygan County Museum has hosted a range of exhibits from temporary traveling exhibitions to those developed by the Museum with objects from the collection. While no longer on view, these exhibitions showcase the diversity of Sheboygan County history. With its ample sunshine, long days, and warm temperatures, summer has always been the season of celebrations. Through the themes of Marching Down Main, Sun’s Out - School’s Out, R & R, Competitions to Cream Puffs, and Festivals & Fry Outs, In Celebration of Summer provided visitors a journey through generations of community traditions and a growing leisure economy with objects from the Museum’s collection

services.name: Weinhold Log Cabin
services.desc: The Weinhold Log Cabin was moved to the Taylor Park property in 1977 from its original location in Adell, near the southern county border.
